w: At 9.15 am Swamishri arrived at the Shilanyas ceremony (foundation-stone laying ritual) for the new Swaminarayan mandir. Amidst Vedic chantings and rituals the foundation stones were laid by Swamishri. Various dignitaries and government officials were present for this historic occasion. Hon. Alan Rocke - Federal Member of Parliament and Minister of Health, Mr. Tony Clement - Provincial MP, Ontario, Mr. Rajnikant Verma - Indian High Commissioner for Canada and Hon. Mayor Mel Lastman honored Swamishri and spoke glowingly of his works. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, saying, "... You have all sacrificed something to become a part of the foundation stones laid here today. You have performed this service with love and heartfelt feelings. To offer support to any person is a service of great merit. Today you have supported this occasion. Though the brick may be small, but the work is great and gigantic. Because the mandir that will be created here will be the house of God. Thousands of people will come here for darshan..."

Reinstating Faith A devotee brought his 17 year old son for Swamishri's blessings. "Bapa! My son is very intelligent in his studies. But for the last six months he has stopped coming to the mandir." "Why?" Swamishri asked. "Because he does not believe in God," the devotee replied. "Why don't you believe in God," Swamishri asked the devotee's son. "Because I haven't seen God," he replied. "But you should have faith in someone who has seen Him. Did you see the astronauts land on the moon? Yet you believe it, isn't it? Likewise you should also believe that there is a God. It is all a matter of faith. Once you start coming here you will gradually understand everything. Don't mentally give up and resign yourself. Ask the sadhus whenever you have any questions." The teenager was convinced and accepted the kanthi at the hands of Swamishri.

w: Hiren, a young boy, was singing the bhajan,
"Tari Murti re chhe jo nenu no shangar. Mohan tari Murti joine bhuli chhu tanbhan..."

before Thakorji in the mandir. Swamishri was engaged in Thakorji's darshan. On hearing the latter verse he came to Hiren and placing his hand on his head said, "tanbhan (means to forget one's body) means to forget TV and study well and offer bhakti.

A few days earlier, Swamishri had advised Hiren regarding a complain about him watching too much TV and not studying at all. Swamishri once again blessed him for his singing and reminded him of his priorities: to forget TV, study well and offer bhakti.

pr.t: Remembering the Sadhus of Shastriji Maharaj
w: In the evening, Swamishri departed from Bochasan mandir to go to Mahelav. On the way Swamishri looked towards the mandir farm, folded his hands and said, "Jai Maharaj! Akshar Swami, Ghanshyam Swami, Bhaktivallabh ... Jai Swaminarayan."
Swamishri respectfully remembered the deceased sadhus (cremated in the farm) initiated by Shastriji Maharaj.
As a leader, Swamishri never fails to appreciate and remember those who have served and sacrificed their lives for God and society.
Would you ever think of sitting in dirt? Following untruth is dirt. No matter how much wealth or luxuries one attains but if it is through falsehood then it is dirt.
One who lives by making thousands miserable is not a man. And one who lives by making thousands happy is a man.

Books that promote untruth should not be read, heard or even looked at. Cultivate the virtues of truth, non-violence, brahmacharya, compassion and charity in oneself so that God will be pleased and our society will become a happier place.

Prasad Pravesh Kirtan Aradhana The inauguration of the first shikharbaddh mandir in America began with a traditional Vedic mahapuja performed by Doctor Swami, followed by the Prasad Pravesh ceremony performed by Swamishri. Under the central dome of the mandir, Swamishri carried out various Vedic rituals to mark the first official entrance into the mandir. In the evening cultural programme, sadhus presented a kirtan aradhana. Viveksagar Swami concluded the kirtan aradhana with a speech explaining the importance of engaging in kirtan bhakti in today's day and age. The Mayor of Stafford, Leonard Scarcella, was present in the kirtan aradhana, and he addressed the assembly. Earlier in the day, he had met Swamishri and honoured him with a Key to the City of Stafford.
